items.computation: The letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday) and runs the 12-day period 'ab dem Datum dieses Briefes', i.e. from that date, excluding public holidays and counting Monday-Friday as stated in the letter. Following the general civil-law counting rule (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), the day of the letter itself is not counted, so counting starts 20.11.2026 (Friday). Counting 12 Arbeitstage (Mon-Fri, skipping the weekends of 21-22.11, 28-29.11 and 05-06.12, no public holiday falls in this window in NW) lands on Monday, 07.12.2026.
